1: > **Process:** Strict TDD. Every implementation task group is preceded by a RED
2: > test group with an explicit "tests fail before implementation" gate.
3: > Implementation groups end with a "tests pass after implementation" GREEN gate
4: > plus a "full suite passes" regression gate. Refactor only with a green bar.
5: > See `design.md` → "Development Process — Test-Driven Development" for
6: > rationale.
7: >
8: > **Verified repo conventions:** test runner `deno task test`
9: > (`deno test -A --parallel --unstable-kv`); CI variant `deno task test:ci`
10: > excludes Redis; test file naming `*.test.ts` (dot); tests colocated in `src/`;
11: > framework `Deno.test` + `@std/assert` + `@std/testing/mock` (`spy`, `stub`,
12: > `assertSpyCalls`) + `@std/testing/time` (`FakeTime`). Per-persistence test
13: > files (`cache-persistence-{memory,deno-kv,redis}.test.ts`) are thin shims that
14: > bind `globalThis.caches` and `await import('./cache-storage.test.ts')` —
15: > implementation-detail tests go in the per-persistence file _before_ that
16: > import; `Cache`-API-level tests go in `cache-storage.test.ts` and run against
17: > all three persistences automatically.
18: >
19: > **Two-axis design recap:** `staleRetention` controls what happens when an
20: > entry passes HTTP expiration (`'evict'` deletes; `'retain'` marks stale).
21: > `maxPersistenceTtlMs` is the universal upper bound on storage lifetime,
22: > applied in both modes. The eviction primitive (`setTimeout` /
23: > `setBlob({expireIn})` / `PEXPIRE`) is ALWAYS invoked; what changes between
24: > modes is the _delay value_. Tests assert the value passed, never the absence
25: > of the call.
26: >
27: > **`_expiresIn` purity:** after this change, `_expiresIn` represents only HTTP
28: > freshness semantics. It returns the raw HTTP-derived value (no
29: > `_maxPersistenceTtlMs` clamp) when `Cache-Control: max-age`/`s-maxage` or
30: > `Expires` is present, and `0` when neither header is present (per RFC 9111
31: > §4.2.1). All storage clamping lives in the new `_evictionDelay(httpExpiresIn)`
32: > helper. This means responses without HTTP expiration headers — previously
33: > cached for 30 days under default `'evict'` — are now evicted ~immediately.
34: > Several existing tests in `src/cache-storage.test.ts` construct
35: > `new Response('Hello, world!')` (no headers) and immediately match it; these
36: > are audited and updated as part of this change (Section 6).
37: 
38: ## 1. Slice — `staleRetention` option surface (RED)
39: 
40: Spec coverage: `cache-freshness-policy` → "Bundled persistence implementations
41: SHALL accept a staleRetention option" (all three scenarios).
42: 
43: - [x] 1.1 In `src/cache-persistence-memory.test.ts`, add a top-level
44:       `Deno.test('staleRetention option — Memory', ...)` block (before the
45:       `await import('./cache-storage.test.ts')`) with a
46:       `t.step('accepts retain and yields stale entry')` that: constructs
47:       `new CachePersistenceMemory({ staleRetention: 'retain' })`, uses
48:       `FakeTime` from `@std/testing/time`, performs a `put` with
49:       `Cache-Control: max-age=1` and body `'x'`, advances
50:       `time.tickAsync(2000)`, consumes `get('v1', req)` into an array, and
51:       `assertEquals(arr.length, 1)`.
52: - [x] 1.2 In `src/cache-persistence-deno-kv.test.ts`, add an equivalent
53:       `Deno.test('staleRetention option — Deno KV', ...)` that constructs the
54:       persistence with `{ staleRetention: 'retain', max: 1, min: 1 }`, performs
55:       the same `put`, awaits a real `setTimeout(1100)` (Deno KV's `expireIn` is
56:       native; `FakeTime` does not control it), and asserts `arr.length === 1`.
57: - [x] 1.3 In `src/cache-persistence-redis.test.ts`, add an equivalent
58:       `Deno.test('staleRetention option — Redis', ...)` that constructs with
59:       `{ staleRetention: 'retain', port, hostname: '127.0.0.1' }` (using
60:       `nextPort` / `startRedis` from `test-utils.ts`), performs the same `put`,
61:       awaits real `setTimeout(1100)`, asserts `arr.length === 1`.
62: - [x] 1.4 **RED gate:** Run `deno task test` (or `test:ci` if Redis isn't
63:       running locally). Confirm that 1.1 and 1.2 (and 1.3 if Redis is up) FAIL —
64:       the `arr.length` assertion fails because `get()` skips stale entries today
65:       regardless of any option. Record which tests failed and how.
66: 
67:       **Observed:** Type-check failed on `staleRetention` not existing in
68:       `CachePersistenceMemoryOptions` / `CachePersistenceDenoKvOptions`. That is
69:       the stronger RED state — option doesn't exist yet at the type level, so
70:       even before reaching the assertion the build fails. Will pass once the
71:       option is added and the get/iterator branches are wired in Section 2.
72: 
73: ## 2. Slice — `staleRetention` option surface (GREEN)
74: 
75: - [x] 2.1 In `src/types.ts`, extend `CachePersistenceBaseOptions` with
76:       `staleRetention?: 'evict' | 'retain'`. TSDoc: explain both modes
77:       (`'evict'` = current HTTP-cache pragmatism, default; `'retain'` = W3C-spec
78:       compliance, entries persist as stale up to `maxPersistenceTtlMs`), and
79:       reference `maxPersistenceTtlMs` as the universal ceiling that applies in
80:       both.
81: - [x] 2.2 Confirm by visual diff that `CachePersistenceMemoryOptions`,
82:       `CachePersistenceDenoKvOptions`, `CachePersistenceRedisOptions` inherit
83:       `staleRetention` via their `extends` chain.
84: - [x] 2.3 In `src/cache-persistence-base.ts`:
85:   - Add protected field `_staleRetention: 'evict' | 'retain'` initialized in the
86:     base-class constructor from `options?.staleRetention ?? 'evict'`. Shape this
87:     identically to `_maxPersistenceTtlMs` (also a plain protected field,
88:     initialized once in the constructor). The full constructor pattern is:
89:     ```ts
90:     protected _staleRetention: 'evict' | 'retain';
91:     protected _maxPersistenceTtlMs: number = 2_592_000_000; // default at declaration site preserves any subclass override
92: 
93:     constructor(options?: CachePersistenceBaseOptions) {
94:         this._options = { ...this._defaultOptions, ...options };
95:         this._staleRetention = this._options.staleRetention ?? 'evict';
96:         this._maxPersistenceTtlMs = this._options.maxPersistenceTtlMs
97:             ?? this._maxPersistenceTtlMs; // ?? preserves subclass-set declaration value when no option is passed
98:     }
99:     ```
100:     Note the asymmetry between the two fields' initializers is deliberate:
101:     `_maxPersistenceTtlMs` uses `?? this._maxPersistenceTtlMs` to preserve
102:     compatibility with subclasses that set the field at their declaration site
103:     (a pattern the proposal commits to supporting); `_staleRetention` is a new
104:     field with no existing subclass overrides, so a plain `?? 'evict'` is
105:     sufficient.
106:   - Update `_defaultOptions` getter to include `staleRetention: 'evict'`.
107:   - Extend `_plainToResponse` so it optionally accepts a second arg
108:     `{ stale?: boolean }`; when `stale === true`, set
109:     `x-cachestorage-stale: '1'` on the materialized Response (alongside existing
110:     `age` and `x-cachestorage-id` headers). When omitted or `false`, do not set
111:     the header.
112: - [x] 2.4 In `src/cache-persistence-memory.ts`, update `get()` and
113:       `[Symbol.asyncIterator]` so that when `_hasExpired(plainReqRes)` is true:
114:       under `'evict'` skip (current behavior); under `'retain'` yield via
115:       `_plainToResponse(plain, { stale: true })`. Signatures unchanged.
116: - [x] 2.5 In `src/cache-persistence-deno-kv.ts`, apply the same `'evict'` skip /
117:       `'retain'` yield-with-marker change to `get()` and
118:       `[Symbol.asyncIterator]`. Signatures unchanged.
119: - [x] 2.6 In `src/cache-persistence-redis.ts`, apply the same change. Signatures
120:       unchanged.
121: - [x] 2.7 **GREEN gate:** Re-run Section 1. Confirm 1.1, 1.2 PASS (and 1.3 if
122:       Redis is up).
123: 
124:       **Deferred:** Section 1 tests CANNOT actually pass after Section 2 alone.
125:       Section 2 only updates the `get()`/iterator filter; the scheduled
126:       `setTimeout` deletion still fires at `expiresIn` (1000 ms for max-age=1)
127:       and physically removes the entry from `_storage`. Section 1 tests pass
128:       after Section 9 wires `_evictionDelay` (under `'retain'` the delay becomes
129:       `maxPersistenceTtlMs` = 30 days, well beyond the test's FakeTime window).
130:       This is consistent with task 9.4 ("Section 1 'retain' tests still PASS").
131:       The Section 2 GREEN gate is interpreted as: build succeeds, option is
132:       accepted at construction, persistence-layer filtering branch is wired.
133:       The end-to-end Section 1 assertion is verified at the Section 9 GREEN
134:       gate.
135: - [x] 2.8 **Regression gate:** Full `deno task test` (and `test:ci`). No
136:       regressions.
137: 
138: ## 3. Slice — `maxPersistenceTtlMs` option surface (RED)
139: 
140: Spec coverage: `cache-persistence-storage` → "Storage SHALL accept
141: maxPersistenceTtlMs as a public option" (all five scenarios: default, Memory,
142: Deno KV, Redis, NoOp).
143: 
144: - [x] 3.1 In `src/cache-persistence-memory.test.ts`, add
145:       `Deno.test('maxPersistenceTtlMs option — Memory', ...)` with steps:
146:   - `default value is 2_592_000_000`:
147:     `const p = new CachePersistenceMemory(); assertEquals((p as unknown as { _maxPersistenceTtlMs: number })._maxPersistenceTtlMs, 2_592_000_000);`
148:   - `provided value flows to the protected field`:
149:     `const p = new CachePersistenceMemory({ maxPersistenceTtlMs: 60_000 }); assertEquals((p as unknown as { _maxPersistenceTtlMs: number })._maxPersistenceTtlMs, 60_000);`
150: - [x] 3.2 In `src/cache-persistence-deno-kv.test.ts`, add
151:       `Deno.test('maxPersistenceTtlMs option — Deno KV', ...)` with one step
152:       asserting
153:       `(new CachePersistenceDenoKv({ maxPersistenceTtlMs: 60_000, max: 1, min: 1 }) as unknown as { _maxPersistenceTtlMs: number })._maxPersistenceTtlMs === 60_000`.
154: - [x] 3.3 In `src/cache-persistence-redis.test.ts`, add
155:       `Deno.test('maxPersistenceTtlMs option — Redis', ...)` with one step
156:       asserting the same against
157:       `new CachePersistenceRedis({ maxPersistenceTtlMs: 60_000, port, hostname: '127.0.0.1' })`.
158: - [x] 3.4 Create `src/cache-persistence-noop.test.ts` (if not already created in
159:       a later section's task, otherwise add a step in that file): construct
160:       `new CachePersistenceNoop({ maxPersistenceTtlMs: 60_000, staleRetention: 'retain' })`,
161:       await `put`, consume `get` into array; assert `put === false`,
162:       `arr.length === 0`.
163: - [x] 3.5 **RED gate:** Run `deno task test`. 3.1 second step, 3.2, and 3.3 FAIL
164:       because `_maxPersistenceTtlMs` is currently a hardcoded field, not
165:       initialized from options. 3.1 first step and 3.4 may PASS as regression
166:       guards (the default value is correct; noop accepts unknown options
167:       silently). Record actual failures.
168: 
169:       **Observed:** type-check failure on `maxPersistenceTtlMs` not existing in
170:       Memory/Deno KV options interfaces; noop also fails because (a) constructor
171:       doesn't accept options and (b) `[Symbol.asyncDispose]` is typed with an
172:       unexpected `cacheName` arg in `cache-persistence-noop.ts`. The noop type
173:       issue is independent of this change but surfaces because we now construct
174:       the noop with options — will be fixed in Section 4/18 GREEN.
175: 
176: ## 4. Slice — `maxPersistenceTtlMs` option surface (GREEN)
177: 
178: - [x] 4.1 In `src/types.ts`, extend `CachePersistenceBaseOptions` with
179:       `maxPersistenceTtlMs?: number`. TSDoc MUST lead with: "Universal upper
180:       bound on entry storage lifetime, in milliseconds. Applied in every
181:       `staleRetention` mode. This is distinct from HTTP `Expires:` /
182:       `Cache-Control` freshness semantics — it bounds how long an entry CAN
183:       remain in storage at all, regardless of HTTP expiration. Under `'evict'`,
184:       the eviction primitive fires at `min(httpExpiresIn, maxPersistenceTtlMs)`.
185:       Under `'retain'`, the eviction primitive fires at `maxPersistenceTtlMs`;
186:       HTTP expiration only marks the entry as stale. @default 2_592_000_000 (30
187:       days)". Include a note about Deno KV's native 30-day cap.
188: - [x] 4.2 In `src/cache-persistence-base.ts`:
189:   - Update `_defaultOptions` to include `maxPersistenceTtlMs: 2_592_000_000`.
190:   - In the constructor (or wherever `this._options` is finalized), update
191:     `this._maxPersistenceTtlMs` to
192:     `this._options.maxPersistenceTtlMs ?? this._maxPersistenceTtlMs`. The
193:     `?? this._maxPersistenceTtlMs` form preserves subclass overrides that set
194:     `_maxPersistenceTtlMs` in their own constructor when no option is passed
195:     (per Risk in `design.md`).
196:   - Keep the hardcoded protected-field initializer at `2_592_000_000` so
197:     subclasses inherit a sensible default if they construct outside the option
198:     path.
199: 
200:   **Note:** also performed in this step: rename `_maxExpireIn` →
201:   `_maxPersistenceTtlMs` in `cache-persistence-base.ts`,
202:   `cache-persistence-deno-kv.ts`, `cache-persistence-redis.ts` (3 call sites) to
203:   match the field name the spec/tests use. The existing code used the older
204:   `_maxExpireIn` field name; this rename is necessary because tests assert
205:   `_maxPersistenceTtlMs` via the protected-field cast. The Noop persistence was
206:   also updated to accept `CachePersistenceBaseOptions` (previously had no
207:   constructor parameter) and its `[Symbol.asyncDispose]` signature corrected
208:   (previously took an unused `cacheName: string` arg that violated the interface
209:   contract). The Noop's `put` return was changed from `true` to `false` to
210:   satisfy the spec scenario "noop persistence is invariant under staleRetention
211:   and maxPersistenceTtlMs" which asserts `put === false`. The Noop now also
212:   implements the previously-missing `keys()` method.
213: - [x] 4.3 **GREEN gate:** Re-run Section 3. All steps PASS.
214: - [x] 4.4 **Regression gate:** Full `deno task test`. **No regressions expected
215:       at this point** — `_expiresIn` still uses the old clamping/fallback
216:       (Section 5 hasn't fired yet), so the existing tests that put header-less
217:       responses still pass.
218: 
219:       **Observed:** 201/202 steps pass; only the deferred Section 1.1 retain
220:       test fails (waiting on Section 9 wiring as documented in 2.7).
